title: Bunk Johnson, Jelly Roll Morton and the dance halls
summary: He calls Bunk a crackerjack street and parade man who played the district and halls like Economy Hall; comments on Morton's fading fame.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
